paragraphs.text: Avenger is an obsolete creature type used to represent a class for people who inflict vengeance in response to something bad that has occurred to them or something they cared about.

Avenger debuted as a creature type in Legends on Righteous Avengers which appeared as a group of human soldiers from Dominaria rushing forward to attack over some righteous cause. It was later made obsolete and given errata to be Soldier with the release of Masters Edition in Magic Online and the Grand Creature Type Update later added the Human race to them as well.
Avengers of varying types have appeared on many planes.
Bant is home to some Giltspire Avengers following the destruction of Giltspire Castle.
Some followers of Oketra are known as Oketra's Avengers .
Some Angels of Serra are known as Serra Avengers .
Guardian statues exist that turn into Soldiers are known as Opal Avengers .
Krosa is home to Krosan Avengers
On Otaria , Gempalm Avenger fight in the Cabal Arena.
In the Sardian Mountains there are goblins known as Sardian Avenger .
Some Treefolk serving Gaea are known as Gaea's Avengers
Urza created shapeshifter artifact creatures known as Avengers .
Some survivors who mourn Avacyn become Dauntless Avengers
Werewolf loners sometimes become Howlpack Avengers
Some Wolfir who serve Avacyn are Wolfir Avengers
Skemfar has a group of berserkers known as Skemfar Avengers .
Nantuko Ninja known as Spring-Leaf Avenger are found during the time of the Neon Dynasty.
Golems known as Lunar Avenger were found on Mirrodin before its being taken over by Phyrexians .
Some members of the Dal tribe where known as Avenger en-Dal .
The Boros Legion has Firemane Avengers as part of its holy Angel warriors.
There exist Djinn Monks known as Sage-Eye Avengers
Some followers of Gideon Jura are called Gideon's Avengers .
Elementals known as Avengers of Zendikar rose to fight the Eldrazi
Sphinx known as Jwar Isle Avenger fought the Eldrazi
Frog Samurai known as Jade Avenger reside on some unknown plane.
Fire and Nature Elementals known as Leafkin Avengers reside on some unknown plane.
A type is rare sword is called the Holy Avenger ( Card )
Various characters also have Avenger as part of their name or epithet.

Asmira , Holy Avenger
Sanwell , Sanwell, Avenger Ace
Rhoda , Geist Avenger
Vivien Reid , Nature's Avenger
Captain America , First Avenger

Gimli , Mournful Avenger
